findings: A composed pilot body now independently binds the complete frozen campaign/numerical/input prerequisite gate, exact pilot slot/request and immutable projection copy before any scientific phase. No CLI or dispatcher was added.

Actual tokenizer/training-ID reconstruction, training, H200 export, validation/sample/result publication and raw/H200 tensor/cache audit are composed inside one600-second pilot resource interval. Bounded output hooks receive the exact projection allowance. Resource completion binds both result and cache audit hashes.

Successful evaluation-attempt identity is checked against request, completed training-output digest, reconstructed training contract and frozen96-token training input before cache/resource completion. Immutable worker attempt and terminal references retain all producer provenance.

Frozen files, attempt/request identity, producer artifact references and STOP are rechecked between phases. Full source/runtime/frozen prerequisites are rebound after the resource thread closes, avoiding concurrent census changes. Failure after resource completion still creates terminal worker failure evidence.
Pilot and quality stage reviews now reject worker failures and partial worker records as well as training/evaluation failures, including when listed in the evidence inventory.

Integration exposed a required controller ordering: the idle complete-campaign storage gate must run before creating an unreviewed slot request/process directory. It correctly rejects those files if called later. The future startup transition must bind that idle receipt and recheck actual disk immediately before dispatch; current storage gate was not weakened.
limitations: Scientific phases, MPS observation and frozen-plan gate were mocked in composition tests; bounded checkpoint/metadata writers and resource recorder were real. Existing real numerical prerequisite gates remain unavailable and prohibit actual pilot use. No MPS model or research training ran.

This is a composable output body, not a complete worker/launcher. The parent still must enforce idle audited full-future-storage acceptance, immutable startup/attempt provenance, bounded subprocess capture and complete per-pilot/stage acceptance. The body deliberately does not claim dispatch or stage authorization.

Successful worker-output provenance must be required by the future controller/stage flow before continuation or cleanup. Nine real rank numerical cases, input review and measured pilots remain outstanding. Full wider memory/time/export feasibility remains unproven.
No research weights were deleted, no scientific budget/order/rate/rule or storage guard changed, no plan was frozen, and no failed numerical fixture or closed campaign was retried.
